meaning:
περι-έχω,
[in LXX for H661, H5362 hi., H6822 pi., etc. ;]
1. to surround, encompass: Luk.5:9 (cf. MM, xix).
2. to comprehend, include, contain, esp. of books: with accusative, Act.23:25, Rec.; accusative to a late usage, intrans. (BL, § 53, 1.3; MM, xix; Hort, in l), it stands written, 1Pe.2:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;
Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”
